headlines.title: Bank of America Q3 profit tumbles 17% as deals, trading revenue fall
headlines.summary: Bank of America said Wednesday that its third quarter profit fell 17% from a year earlier as $1.2 billion regulatory penalty and a slowdown in its Wall Street machine dented higher lending income.

headlines.title: Bank of America stock falls on earnings miss
headlines.summary: Investing.com -- Bank of America Corp (NYSE: BAC) shares are down more than 3% premarket after the company reported third-quarter adjusted earnings per share of $1.08, missing analyst estimates of $1.10, as the bank took a $1.2 billion regulatory settlement charge that weighed on results.

headlines.title: Bank of America Results Hit by Weaker Trading, $1.2 Billion Penalty
headlines.summary: Bank of America's stock and fixed-income traders missed estimates in the third quarter, with bond-trading revenue falling 17% to $2.55 billion and equity trading down 10% to $2.51 billion. The bank's results were also hurt by a charge tied to a regulatory penalty over money laundering and sanctions violations. Kristine Aquino reports on Bloomberg Television.

headlines.title: Bank of America (NYSE:BAC) Misses Q3 2026 Revenue Estimates
headlines.summary: Financial services giant Bank of America (NYSE:BAC) fell short of the market’s revenue expectations in Q3 2026 as sales rose 2.6% year on year to $29.96 billion. Its GAAP profit of $0.91 per share was 17.6% below analysts’ consensus estimates.

headlines.title: Bank of America Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
headlines.summary: Bank of America reported its third quarter 2026 financial results today. The news release, supplemental filing and investor presentation can be accessed at Bank of America's Investor Relations website at https://investor.bankofamerica.com/quarterly-earnings.

description: Bank of America Corporation, through its subsidiaries, provides various financial products and services for individual consumers, small and middle-market businesses, institutional investors, large corporations, and governments worldwide. It operates through four segments: Consumer Banking, Global Wealth & Investment Management (GWIM), Global Banking, and Global Markets. The Consumer Banking segment offers traditional and money market savings accounts, certificates of deposit and IRAs, checking accounts, and investment accounts and products; credit and debit cards; residential mortgages and home equity loans; and direct and indirect loans. The GWIM segment provides investment management, brokerage, banking, and trust and retirement products and services; wealth management solutions; and customized solutions, including specialty asset management services. The Global Banking segment offers lending products and services, including commercial loans, leases, commitment facilities, trade finance, and commercial real estate and asset-based lending; treasury solutions, and underwriting and advisory services. The Global Markets segment provides market-making, financing, securities clearing, settlement, and custody services; securities and derivative products; and risk management products using interest rate, equity, credit, currency and commodity derivatives, foreign exchange, fixed-income, and mortgage-related products. Bank of America Corporation was founded in 1784 and is based in Charlotte, North Carolina.
